stories.title: SPD: Lars Klingbeil kündigt Neuwahl der Parteispitze zum Jahreswechsel an

en.title: SPD: Lars Klingbeil announces re-election of party leadership at year's end
en.summary: SPD party leader Lars Klingbeil announced that the entire party leadership will stand for re-election at a winter party conference following the withdrawal of his co-chair Bärbel Bas.

stories.title: Rücktritt von Bärbel Bas: Friedrich Merz würdigt Bärbel Bas nach ihrem Rücktritt

en.title: Resignation of Bärbel Bas: Friedrich Merz honors Bärbel Bas after her resignation
en.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz thanked Bas for her cooperation and commitment. An SPD politician criticized attacks from the Union party as inhumane and reckless.

stories.title: Deutschland liveblog: Klingbeil: Neuwahl der ganzen Parteispitze zum Jahreswechsel

en.title: Germany liveblog: Klingbeil: Re-election of entire party leadership at year's end
en.summary: SPD leader Klingbeil announced party leadership re-elections at year's end, Schweitzer will become labor minister, and Chancellor Merz expressed appreciation for Bas's cooperation.

stories.title: Wirtschafsnobelpreis geht an US-Ökonomen Robert E. Hall und Michael Woodford

en.title: Economics Nobel Prize goes to US economists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
en.summary: The Swedish Nobel Committee awarded the economics prize to American scientists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford.

stories.title: Krieg gegen die Ukraine: EU verhängt Sanktionen gegen 1.600 Unterstützer Russlands

en.title: War against Ukraine: EU imposes sanctions against 1,600 Russian supporters
en.summary: EU foreign ministers approved their most comprehensive Russia sanctions to date, targeting 1,600 supporters of Russia. The EU expressed doubt about Trump's proposed energy ceasefire.

stories.title: Ehrung: US-Forscher Robert E. Hall und Michael Woodford erhalten Wirtschaftsnobelpreis

en.title: Honor: US researchers Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford receive Economics Nobel Prize
en.summary: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm announced that US researchers Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford received the Economics Nobel Prize.

stories.title: Auszeichnung: Robert E. Hall und Michael Woodford erhalten Wirtschaftsnobelpreis

en.title: Award: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford receive Economics Nobel Prize
en.summary: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford received this year's Economics Nobel Prize for their research on macroeconomic models that can dampen economic fluctuations.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Ukraine-Krieg: EU verhängt Rekord-Sanktionen gegen russische Kriegshelfer

en.title: News blog on Ukraine war: EU imposes record sanctions against Russian war helpers
en.summary: The EU imposed record sanctions affecting approximately 1,600 individuals, companies, and organizations, according to EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas.

stories.title: Beben in Bundesregierung: Bärbel Bas tritt von allen Ämtern zurück – Schweitzer wird Arbeitsminister

en.title: Upheaval in Federal Government: Bärbel Bas resigns from all offices – Schweitzer becomes Labor Minister
en.summary: Bärbel Bas, SPD leader and labor minister, has resigned from all her positions citing the death of her stepdaughter and attacks from the opposition Union party against her and the chancellor.

stories.title: Nach Rücktritt von Bas: Schweitzer soll neuer Arbeitsminister werden

en.title: After Bas's resignation: Schweitzer to become new Labor Minister
en.summary: Following Bärbel Bas's resignation, the SPD has named Alexander Schweitzer, former minister president of Rhineland-Palatinate, as the new labor and social affairs minister during a challenging period.

stories.title: Neue Sanktionen gegen Russland: EU-Außenminister treffen sich in Luxemburg

en.title: New sanctions against Russia: EU foreign ministers meet in Luxembourg
en.summary: EU foreign ministers are meeting in Luxembourg to discuss new sanctions against Russia.

stories.title: Johann Wadepuhl: EU-Außenminister planen bislang größtes Sanktionspaket gegen Russland

en.title: Johann Wadepuhl: EU foreign ministers plan largest sanctions package against Russia to date
en.summary: EU foreign ministers are planning the largest sanctions package against Russia yet, adding 1,600 names from Russia's military-industrial complex to the sanctions list, with Germany playing a leading role.

stories.title: Nobelpreis: US-Forscher Robert E. Hall und Michael Woodford gewinnen Wirtschaftsnobelpreis

en.title: Nobel Prize: US researchers Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford win Economics Nobel Prize
en.summary: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford have been awarded this year's Economics Nobel Prize for their research on macroeconomic models that can dampen economic fluctuations.

stories.title: SPD: Arbeitsministerin und SPD-Chefin Bas tritt zurück – Alexander Schweitzer wird neuer Minister

en.title: SPD: Labor minister and SPD co-chair Bas steps down – Alexander Schweitzer becomes new minister
en.summary: SPD co-chair and Labor Minister Bas is resigning following a family bereavement. Vice Chancellor Klingbeil has criticized attacks against her as inappropriate.

stories.title: Bundespolitik: Klingbeil kündigt Neuwahl der SPD-Spitze an – und nennt Angriffe gegen Bas „unanständig“

en.title: Federal politics: Klingbeil announces SPD leadership reelection – calls attacks against Bas "indecent"
en.summary: SPD Vice Chancellor Klingbeil has announced a new election for the party leadership and condemned attacks on Bas as indecent, while political opponents expressed respect for her.

stories.title: Dax aktuell: Dax notiert im Plus – VW-Aktie legt zu

en.title: Dax current: Dax trading in positive territory – VW share gains
en.summary: Germany's leading stock index continues its recovery with automotive stocks particularly in focus. Investors are also watching the start of the IMF and World Bank annual meeting.
